choice_text.1770780272411963392: Congrats, Mendez, way to be a prick.
choice_text.1770781317716406272: What's goin' on? I live right upstairs.
choice_text.1770781802628280320: So keep on livin' and stop mindin' other people's biz.
choice_text.1770784639051526144: Sure, why not. It's not like we're miles apart.
choice_text.1770784760921223168: I dunno. Sounds too personal for me. I'm not the best shoulder to cry on.
choice_text.1770785328645435392: Thanks. Just... be patient. Cops fallen on rough times can be... touchy.
choice_text.1770785631709065216: Think about it, OK? Barry's a good guy, and a good cop. He doesn't deserve to end up alone.
choice_text.1195127130269732864: Barry! We know you're in there. We're here to help.
choice_text.1832833633937506304: We came here as colleagues – nothin' else. Haven't heard from you in a while. We're worried.
choice_text.1832848394599251968: Oh, what, so I'm the bad guy? I'm not the one who's holed up, playin' the attention whore.
choice_text.1832848491923881984: He lost a friend. Can you blame him?
choice_text.1832899704023400448: Mendez, hold on! It's his neighbor!
choice_text.1832923518157438976: I'll see what I can do.
choice_text.1832923920693182464: I'll consider it. Can't promise anything.
choice_text.1837086825797894148: Is there anything I can do?
choice_text.1837086994241142784: Is there anything I can do?
choice_text.1837087155973505024: This is a megatower. Spilling to badges'll get you pegged as a snitch.
choice_text.1837087627664932864: He's a friend from the precinct. Left the force not long ago.
choice_text.1837093085427515392: Maybe. You know Barry at all?
choice_text.1837093264457187328: More or less. Struck up a convo once or twice.
choice_text.1837093936904781824: This'll only take a sec. Do you know Barry?
choice_text.1837094695620820992: He broke down after his best friend died. We're worried he'll do something stupid.
choice_text.1837094846498324480: Relaaax, Petrova. Barry's got nerves o' steel – he's just a spiteful ol' bastard.
choice_text.1895117964848119808: Cut the bullshit, just open up!
choice_text.1895150929896521728: He's not the first or the last. It's called life.
choice_text.1895159326003937280: Someone in this tower go cuckoo again?
choice_text.1895186712057593856: Could you check in on him when he's chilled down?
choice_text.1895206434161541120: This is a private matter, so just move along.

choice_text.1772112117208608768: Barry? Am I rememberin' that right?
choice_text.1772116722118193152: People like us have to get used to loss.
choice_text.1772118135397314560: Just wanna talk, that's all. I know it's what you need right now, even if you don't wanna admit it.
choice_text.1772118743839830016: I can't turn back time for you, but I can sit next to you and listen...  remind you that you're not in this alone.
choice_text.1772118999457492996: Your friends asked me to drop by.
choice_text.1772120695365595136: You should get out there, live a little!
choice_text.1772121400058998784: Just wanted to see what's shakin'. Friends say you never leave your unit. Think I've got an inkling as to why.
choice_text.1772122036754345984: You can't let yourself fall apart, Barry. Not here, not in Night City.
choice_text.1772219995496017920: Now hold on a sec. We barely know each other, and you just rock up here talkin' to me about my problems?
choice_text.1772222129339789312: Alright, you got me. Your friends asked me to drop in on you, so I thought, hey, why not.
choice_text.1772226181909868544: Alright, come on in. You wanna talk, so let's talk.
choice_text.1772230192000036864: Tell Petrova and Mendez to drop the act already. Mendez especially.
choice_text.1772241123044126720: I lost someone close to me, too. A damned good friend.
choice_text.1772241740697333760: Whaddyou mean "too?" Wait, this about Andrew? They... told you about him.
choice_text.1772242131874902016: Best bud I ever had... known him my whole life. Only person I could spill to without bein' judged.
choice_text.1772244079743234048: We have to forget the dead.
choice_text.1772244463975034880: Can you tell me how Andrew died?
choice_text.1772244910802628608: Does it matter? Normally. From old age. It's no wonder, seein' as he was only a few years younger than my grandma.
choice_text.1772245939564736512: Mendez doesn't know shit about life. Everyone's got their limits, even him. He just hasn't reached 'em. Not like you.
choice_text.1772246354498842624: What if he's right though? Maybe my genes are soft? Don't only the strongest survive?
choice_text.1772246468885901312: If you felt nothing, that means his loss wouldn't have had any meaning.
choice_text.1772247209633542144: Mendez is right. You gotta toughen up. Tell the world to go fuck itself.
choice_text.1793747692638334976: Hey, Barry! Everything' all right in there?
choice_text.2119785631145299972: Silence is as good as yes!
choice_text.1837130920566177792: V, your neighbor from upstairs. Remember me? Talked about preem rides.
choice_text.1837131091962216448: You gave me this look... I was about to hightail it to the Badlands right then an' there.
choice_text.1837131550449975296: Back then you were pumped 'bout the Mizutani Shion. I said it was for flash-posers.
choice_text.1837160190080434176: You're a badge. Ex-badge, but still. You've gotta stay strong... if you won't, who will?
choice_text.1837180973292961792: He's a stand-up guy. Who cares if he has shitty taste when it comes to street-shredders?
choice_text.1837181622453780480: Come back just to get your ass kicked?
choice_text.1837181755329331200: Man, you really know how to cheer a guy up. Maybe those two asshats really are worried about me...?
choice_text.1837195889110401024: Maybe I don't wanna solve anything? That cross your mind?
choice_text.1837196278341812224: You should get out there more – go for a drink with your pals. Life goes on, Barry, and it won't wait for you to catch up.
choice_text.1837196537096814592: Wallowing in loneliness and self-loathing isn't gonna solve anything.
choice_text.1837197199327084544: Well... alright then. Come on in. Not like you'll change anythin'.
choice_text.1841510432347242496: I've seen that look before. It's all too common 'mong people like us.
choice_text.1841510576396419072: "Us?" You don't look like a cop.
choice_text.1841510674224365568: Badges don't get a monopoly on loss. You see death every day in my line of work.
choice_text.1841510817283686400: You get used to it, of course... until it hits someone you're close to.
choice_text.1841603088951787520: Dyin' of old age? In Night City? That merits a monument. Whole world should gaze up at it in awe.
choice_text.1841603265448099840: Hehehe... Ashbox in a niche'll have to do.
choice_text.1841696313347653632: Right... so I'm just supposed to forget everythin' I've seen? That kid, even Andrew?
choice_text.1841696432616882176: He's gone, and you're here. It's time to stop living in the past.
choice_text.1841696569938395136: You won't change anythin' by sittin' here alone and wallowing in misery.
choice_text.1842890146919989248: I'm gonna take that as a yes!
choice_text.1895218491762130944: Heh, you don't forget a gonk thing like that.
choice_text.1895290963312230400: Where'd you get the idea somethin' with me was up? You watchin' me? Someone send you?
choice_text.1895316828007940096: None o' you get it, OK? None o' you!
choice_text.1895381606264979460: What about your friends on the force?
choice_text.1895381798296993792: Guessin' things at the NCPD haven't changed a lick, huh?
choice_text.1895382011434745856: One time... a Maelstrom ganger killed a young kid right in front of my eyes, for shits 'n' giggles.
choice_text.1895382153453879296: I couldn't do shit. The sonofabitch had corpo protection.
choice_text.1895382362850312192: Our chief greases his palms with an anonymous donation and guess what. Officially? Kid blew his own brains out.
choice_text.1895382503074283520: Somethin' died in me then. I couldn't do it anymore... few months later Andrew passed and everythin' went to shit.
choice_text.1895383914172366848: You didn't have anyone to unload on at work? How about Petrova and Mendez?
choice_text.1895403036356624384: Petrova's a decent gal, but she's not good with this stuff. Mendez just doesn't get it.
choice_text.1895403137036697600: He thinks us blues need to be tough. Can't bear the sight of a kid gettin' murdered? Born with pussy genes, 'ccordin' to him.
choice_text.1895403304540422144: But you told him about Andrew.
choice_text.1895403562372677632: Honestly? I thought about it a lot. Anyway... they don't know everything. Better that way.
choice_text.1895441300924907520: Thanks for the talk, V. I, uh... I need time to take all this in.
choice_text.1905551821829292032: Right in front of your eyes.
choice_text.1967849460209532928: So Andrew was like a grandpa to you?
choice_text.1967849848669192192: So then Andrew was more like a grandpa to you than a friend?
choice_text.1967850945345470464: Hm. Wouldn't go that far. He was like a... egh, I don't know... A window into the past, or somethin'.
choice_text.1967851060621721600: He reminded me of my gram-grams, about our little talks... time when everything had its proper place, y'know?
choice_text.1967851178498441216: He was the last... living record of those times.

choice_text.1773708994622418944: A tortoise?! Is this some kinda joke?
choice_text.1773710554668625920: Aren't you going a little overboard?
choice_text.1773710833354960896: Barry's not OK. I mean, if that tortoise was the one thing that got him up in the morning...
choice_text.1773711948939161600: Aren't you goin' a little overboard? He had a bond, I get that, but does that mean you gotta dive straight down the rabbit-hole?
choice_text.1773712301646573568: You can ignore the facts all you want – doesn't mean the problem's just gonna up and disappear.
choice_text.2412964742667714560: A tortoise? Is this a joke?
choice_text.1841757026116157440: I don't know about you, but Barry didn't seem like the kinda pig to crack jokes.
choice_text.1841764984019468288: Now you're starting to get it.
choice_text.1841765087266455552: His friends have to know. Hopefully it's not too late.
choice_text.1841780719051587584: If I were you, I'd tell his pals. People've done dumber things over less than a dead tortoise.
choice_text.1896593619611795456: But a tortoise...? It makes no sense, Johnny! Barry said he was the only person he could spill his guts to...
choice_text.1896593710628192256: That not a good enough reason to buy a niche in a wall – pay a visit from time to time?
choice_text.1896621386508255232: You know how it goes. Stare too long into the abyss, the abyss'll stare right back atcha.
choice_text.1896621485242171392: Takin' a step into it wouldn't be so drastic – considerin' the shit he's seen in his lifetime.
choice_text.1967909587251871744: Gonk blew eddies lookin' after an expensive-ass tortoise... just so he could talk to it?
choice_text.1967909895147339776: Ahh, you're right... I sound like an asshole.
choice_text.1967910003075170304: Picture this – you've got no one. Beloved granny's been in the ground for years. Only thing she left behind's a dumb-fucking tortoise.
choice_text.1967910609235984384: Guy was depressed as shit – only friends he had wouldn't listen. What the fuck else was he s'posed to do?
choice_text.1967910959795912704: But when grandma told ya about life, that tortoise was there. When that same life kicked ya in the nads, when poor grams croaked, it was right there.
choice_text.1967911212225904640: Imagine how alone you've gotta be to buy a niche for a goddamn animal.

choice_text.1793827762354679808: Hmph, it's you. You talk to Barry? He finally decide to get his shit together?
choice_text.1841843375376678912: Hey, so what did Barry tell you exactly about that friend he lost?
choice_text.1841843452082110464: What did Barry tell you about his dead friend?
choice_text.1841855909919965184: Not much. Hardly ever spoke about him. Said once he was the only one who could understand him.
choice_text.1841856078480654336: It's nice to have someone like that.
choice_text.1896484015133409280: We had a little chat. He seems chilled, but seriously down in the dumps. Think he's got a bone to pick with Mendez.
choice_text.1896484102794362880: Got no idea. Ask him yourself.
choice_text.1896487404768575488: Clearly, he couldn't stand his job and didn't have anyone to talk to about it.
choice_text.1896489395251036160: What...? So why doesn't he say so to my face?!
choice_text.1896499997243588608: You fuckin' bet I will! His little temper tantrum must be over if he spilled to you.
choice_text.1896500213988442112: Only thing I don't know is whether to give 'im a taste of my fist or a shot of Bumelant.
choice_text.1896500346343899136: Thanks for your help. This is for your trouble.
choice_text.1896513332529840128: He said you didn't even try to understand him.
choice_text.1896514249236922368: Egh, gimme a break. Barry likes playin' the drama queen – you just gotta shake some sense into 'im, trust me.
choice_text.1896514356074233856: We'll see... We'll have to check in on him later.
choice_text.1896658787603562496: Barry isn't in great shape. So much so, in fact, that he preferred to talk to a tortoise 'stead of you two.
choice_text.1896809022103470080: The complete opposite. It's sad as hell.
choice_text.1896809763119546368: And apart from you guys all he had was... a tortoise. His best friend. A memento of his grandma. Till he died, that is.
choice_text.1896809888629899264: Fuck... I don't fucking believe this. You're bullshittin' me!
choice_text.1896811502698741760: Right. 'Cause I love to bullshit badges.
choice_text.1896811799739351040: You want proof? Niche in the columbarium speaks for itself.
choice_text.1896811958082715648: Right. 'Cause I like to bullshit badges in my spare time.
choice_text.1896825827169648640: Why would he lie to us though? He talked about that tortoise like it was a normal person!
choice_text.1896859868392570880: How do you think Mendez'd react if Barry admitted that he was talking to animals?
choice_text.1896860616002093056: Jesus, Barry... I thought he was bein' a drama queen, that he'd get over it... I gotta go and talk to 'im.
choice_text.1967956602883129344: Barry didn't handle badge life too well. You made fun of him, so he stopped sharin' things.

choice_text.1896561456749199360: Barry... Barry, you fucking asshole! I'm sorry, OK? I'm sorry... I'm so sorry...
choice_text.1896562543963127808: Mendez... It's too late. He can't hear you.
choice_text.1896562750792646656: Your... your genes were fine, Barry! You were the strongest son of a bitch I knew!
choice_text.1896563057312382976: I-I'm so... I'm so sorry, Barry, I... I'm sorry...
choice_text.1896865735099793408: Already told you – you ain't got a warrant, you ain't comin' in.
choice_text.1896880223215665152: Dammit, Barry... can't we just talk?
choice_text.1896880474353811456: Petrova told me your last case was... a real ballbuster. Boss told you to keep your lips sealed, huh?
choice_text.1896880561209458688: Had a similar situation once, y'know. Fuckin' child-killer. Dirtbag was on the Petrochem board, so it was out of our hands.
choice_text.1905575970232582144: Remember it to this day... that little kid's t-shirt. Green with this... funny yellow cat.
